definitions.explanation: A mathematical relationship in which one quantity increases (or decreases) in the same ratio as another — if one doubles, the other doubles. Contrasted with {反比例|はんぴれい} (inverse proportion). Also used in everyday Japanese to describe any situation where two things rise and fall together.

examples.japanese: {正比例|せいひれい}の{関係|かんけい}。
{努力|どりょく}と{成果|せいか}は{正比例|せいひれい}するとは{限|かぎ}らない。
examples.english: Effort and results are not always directly proportional.

examples.japanese: {距離|きょり}は{時間|じかん}に{正比例|せいひれい}して{増|ふ}えていく。
examples.english: The distance increases in direct proportion to the time.

examples.japanese: {給料|きゅうりょう}は{働|はたら}いた{時間|じかん}に{正比例|せいひれい}するので、{残業|ざんぎょう}すればその{分|ぶん}{増|ふ}える。
examples.english: The salary is directly proportional to the hours worked, so it increases by the amount of overtime.

notes:
Composed of {正|せい} (direct, positive, correct) and {比例|ひれい} (proportion). In mathematics, two quantities x and y are in {正比例|せいひれい} when y = kx for some constant k — as x increases, y increases by the same ratio.

Beyond math class, the word appears in everyday discussion of cause-and-effect relationships, especially when people want to say that one thing rises and falls with another.

USAGE:
- As a noun: {正比例|せいひれい}の{関係|かんけい} (a directly proportional relationship)
- As a suru-verb: AはBに{正比例|せいひれい}する (A is directly proportional to B)
- Often used with に (the standard of comparison is marked by に)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {正比例|せいひれい}する: to be directly proportional
- {正比例|せいひれい}{関係|かんけい}: proportional relationship
- Aに{正比例|せいひれい}してBが{増|ふ}える: B increases in direct proportion to A
- {正比例|せいひれい}のグラフ: a graph of direct proportion (a straight line through the origin)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {反比例|はんぴれい}: inverse proportion — the direct antonym; as one increases, the other decreases proportionally
- {比例|ひれい}: proportion (general) — often used when the direction (direct or inverse) is clear from context
- {連動|れんどう}: moving together, linked movement — less mathematical; describes things that change together without specifying a ratio
